name: ACC Cross Country Championships
where: Blacksburg, VA · host Virginia Tech · Buford Meredith XC Course
headline: ACC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 2 NC State won the women's title with 65 points, ahead of Clemson (113), as Hannah Gapes took the individual title in 18:23.8. On the men's side, No. 10 Wake Forest won with 48 points, with Virginia Tech and Syracuse tied at 94 and Notre Dame fourth at 95; Louisville's Elsingi Kiruto won the 8K in 22:03.5, with Wake Forest's Rocky Hansen second in 22:10.0.
